prompt: Why is the delivery date not a reliable guide to the correct card?
promptZh: 為什麼不能靠送達日期來判斷該用哪種卡？

options.text: The register no longer lists dates.
options.zh: 登記冊已不再列出日期。
options.whyZh: 不是缺日子，而是日期無法說明現在裝的支撐銷。

options.text: The green cards have not arrived yet.
options.whyZh: 備忘錄說庫房已有兩種卡。

options.text: Most new cartons were packed without a support pin.
options.zh: 大多數新紙箱都未裝支撐銷。
options.whyZh: 文章未說新箱普遍缺銷。

options.text: A previously delivered carton may have received a different pin later.
options.zh: 先前到貨的紙箱後來可能換了不同的銷。
options.whyZh: 有些舊箱在五月重開更換長銷，所以到貨日期不能確定目前配件。

explanationZh: 有些舊箱在五月重開更換長銷，所以到貨日期不能確定目前配件。
evidence: Some older cartons were reopened to receive longer pins during the May repacking. | the date the carton was delivered does not give that information.

vocabulary.note: 重新拆箱更換或檢查內容物。

difficultyRationale: 聯繫五月舊箱重新換銷與配卡的實際依據。
